title: Independently repeat the retrieval fixture example
question: Can another contributor repeat both the passing candidate and rejected unchanged baseline?
baseline: Frozen artifacts in examples/retrieval/contract.json at the checked-out commit.
resources: Python 3.11+, make, a CPU laptop. No network is needed after checkout.
acceptance: Run make demo in a clean checkout and record all file hashes and the checkout commit.
Run make demo-reject; confirm the unchanged baseline cannot meet the gain threshold.
Compare per-query outputs with examples/retrieval/results/result.json. Report disagreements.
State that these public fixtures do not establish model capability or generalization.
Name the independent contributor and environment. Maintainers review replication credit.
evidence: Result JSON with file hashes and environment.
Time, attempt count, independent worker identity, and limitations.
stop_conditions: A frozen hash or expected result differs; report it before changing code.
deliverable: A replication record and raw result links. Do not change the grader, fixtures, baseline, or threshold.
